definitions.short: Guni , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H1476. Guni גּוּנִי proper name, masculine 1. a Naphtalite Gen 46:24 ; Num 26:48 ; 1Chr 7:13 . 2 1Chr 5:15 a Gadite.

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.
The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.
